name: vsor-site-runtime
description: The materialized site-runtime shell (.vsor/site-runtime). Generated by vsor from this template; the one home of the shell's exact dependency versions (specs/vsor/build). Versions mirror packages/sor-site/package-lock.json, and packages/vsor/tests/test_site_runtime.py asserts that mirror pin-by-pin (before 2026-08-14 the claim here was that `make surface` proved this file; it does not — the e2e harness resolves from the npm workspace and never reads this shell). The design-system block is listed explicitly rather than left to the theme tarball's own transitive resolution: the shell is where a build's versions are pinned, so the site a user builds runs the same tailwind/radix/lucide the surface suite proved.
